title: Customizable Serial Dilution for OT-2
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware files
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files (if needed).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file (with a .py extension) to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App (see the OT App support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Execute serial dilution steps
steps.instruction: Run the customizable serial‑dilution workflow (driven by four text files) using a P300 GEN2 single‑channel pipette. The four sequential actions are:

substeps.instruction: Add diluent to the serial dilution plate.
Add sample to the serial dilution plate.
Perform serial dilution across the plate.
Cherry‑pick to load the final plate.
